name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is giving its opinion on how the EU's Digital Markets Act is being enforced. It asks the European Commission to act faster and more firmly against big tech companies it has labelled "gatekeepers", to use all its powers including fines, to watch new areas like artificial intelligence and cloud computing, and to keep Parliament informed. It also names specific companies it says are not complying properly.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to enforce existing rules harder.
- **Who it affects:** Big tech gatekeepers such as Google, Apple, Meta, TikTok, Microsoft and Booking.com, plus their users.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act; a review of the law is expected.
